notes: οὐκέτι takes the whole negation headed on no; heading on more as the -έτι element is the competing reading and is named in the unit.
συνέζευξεν keeps together inside its own unit as the preverb's realization (rule 106); χωριζέτω heads on asunder as the meaning-bearing complement of a light-verb rendering (rules 17, 91).
